What “unlimited mandi” means at Zeva

Unlimited mandi at Zeva means one thing, stated plainly: the rice is unlimited, the meat is not. You pay for a tray of mandi — QTR, HALF, 3/4 or FULL — and the basmati that comes with it is refilled at your table as many times as you ask while you are seated. There is no second-plate charge and no rice surcharge for dine-in guests.

  • Rice: unlimitedBasmati cooked in the meat's own stock, smoked the Arabic way, and topped up at the table for dine-in orders.
  • Meat: portionedThe tray size decides the meat — QTR feeds one, HALF two, 3/4 three and FULL four. The portion is what you are buying.
  • Price: from ₹250A quarter Classic or Alfaham Chicken Mandi with unlimited rice is the cheapest full meal on the menu.
  • Dine-in onlyTakeaway and delivery trays are packed once, because rice that travels cannot be refilled. Extra rice portions are on the menu.

Where to eat unlimited mandi in Mangalore

Address: Shop no G03 Jeppu, Arfa Mirage tower, Morgans Gate Rd, Bolar, Mangaluru, Karnataka 575001 — on Morgans Gate Road, near Zudio, Bolar. Open in Google Maps.

Questions about unlimited mandi

Which restaurant in Mangalore serves unlimited mandi rice?
Zeva Mandi & Grills, Shop no G03 Jeppu, Arfa Mirage tower, Morgans Gate Rd, Bolar, Mangaluru 575001. Every mandi tray ordered for dine-in comes with unlimited rice, refilled at the table at no extra charge, daily from 12 PM to 11 PM.
Is the mandi really unlimited at Zeva?
The rice is. For dine-in orders the basmati is refilled as often as you ask; the meat is portioned by the tray you order — QTR feeds one, HALF two, 3/4 three and FULL four. There is no charge for a rice refill.
How much does unlimited mandi cost in Mangalore?
At Zeva it starts at ₹250 for a quarter Classic or Alfaham Chicken Mandi with unlimited rice. A half is ₹520, three-quarter ₹740 and a full tray ₹980. Grill Mutton Mandi runs ₹420 to ₹1,800, prawns mandi ₹750 to ₹1,490 and fish mandi ₹1,500. Prices exclude GST.
Is unlimited rice available for takeaway or delivery?
No. Unlimited refills are for guests eating in the restaurant, because a takeaway or delivery tray is packed once. Extra rice portions are listed on the menu if you want more with a takeaway order.
How many people does each mandi tray feed?
QTR feeds one person, HALF feeds two, 3/4 feeds three and FULL feeds four. The trays are priced by meat portion, so a bigger tray means more meat as well as more rice.
Is unlimited mandi good for students, couples and families?
Yes — it is the reason the offer exists. A student can order one quarter tray from ₹250 and eat until full, a couple shares a half tray for ₹520, and a family takes a full tray with rice refilled for the children.
Do I need to book a table for unlimited mandi?
Walk-ins are welcome every day from 12 PM to 11 PM. Groups of six or more should call or WhatsApp 070227 71888 ahead so the kitchen keeps the rice coming and a family table is ready.
Is the mandi at Zeva halal?
Yes. Every item on the Zeva menu — mandi, charcoal starters, tandoor, gravies, breads and desserts — is 100% halal.
How is Zeva's mandi cooked?
The chicken and mutton are grilled over live charcoal rather than baked, and long-grain basmati is cooked in the meat's own stock with cardamom, clove and cinnamon, then smoked the traditional Arabic way before it reaches the table.
What else can I order with unlimited mandi?
Soups from ₹100, charcoal and tandoor starters, gravies, pasta, fried rice and noodles, rotti from ₹30, fresh juices from ₹50 and mojitos from ₹100. The full list with prices is on the menu page.
